EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I've been coming up with my own
rules to live by.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You know, as part
of my self-improvement plan.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But if a new town ordinance went
into effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'd be sure to follow it.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
You don't have to worry about me!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}He estado pensando en reglas para
guiar mi vida, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿sabes? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Es mi manera
de mejorar como persona.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}claro, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}si hubiera alguna
ordenanza en el pueblo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡la seguiría
a rajatabla!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La première chose à faire si je veux
enrichir ma personnalité, c'est de
me fixer ma propre discipline.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais ne t'inquiète pas : si la ville
promulgue un nouvel arrêté, il va
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}sans dire que je m'y plierai !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ho deciso che d'ora in poi voglio
vivere a modo mio.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Ho in mente
un piano di automiglioramento.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ad ogni modo, se entrasse in vigore
una nuova ordinanza,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} la seguirei
sicuramente,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} non temere!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kendim için birkaç yaşam kuralı
belirliyordum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hani, kendimi geliştirme
planımın parçası olarak. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama yeni
bir kasaba yönetmeliği yürürlüğe girerse,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ona da mutlaka uyarım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Benim
için endişelenmene gerek yok!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Not having any ordinances gives us
a lot of freedom,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but I don't mind
following reasonable rules either.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Que no haya ordenanzas nos da
mucha libertad, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}pero a mí no me
importaría seguir algunas normas.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aucun arrêté, c'est la liberté
totale ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais je n'ai rien contre la
discipline et les règles, tu sais.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Non avere delle ordinanze ci lascia
molto liberi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma{{TAG:0003:0001:}} a me non dispiace
seguire le regole,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Keine Verordnungen zu haben gibt
uns viele Freiheiten, aber trotzdem
kenne ich gerne die Regeln...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yönetmelik olmaması bize çok özgürlük
veriyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ama makul kurallara uymak
da beni rahatsız etmez.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Because we don't have any town
ordinances in place,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} everyone here
sort of does their own thing.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En este pueblo no hay ordenanzas,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}así que cada uno va a su aire.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aucun arrêté n'a été promulgué
dans cette ville. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Chacun fait un peu
ce qu'il veut, du coup.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In questa città non è in vigore
nessuna ordinanza{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} e ognuno vive
secondo le proprie regole.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hier im Ort gibt es gar keine
Verordnungen, so macht jeder
das, was er für richtig hält.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kasabada yürürlükte yönetmelik olmadığı
için,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} herkes biraz kendi
bildiğini yapıyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Waking up early feels so good!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's
part of a healthy lifestyle for me.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Thank you for thinking about the
well-being of {{TAG:0005:0005:}}'s
residents.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Levantarse temprano me sienta
muy bien! Es una manera de tener
un estilo de vida más saludable.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gracias por preocuparte de
la salud de los vecinos.
Eres muy bue{{TAG:000E:0006:02006E0004006E006100}} alcald{{TAG:000E:0006:020065000600650073006100}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tôt couché, tôt levé, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}c'est du pain
bénit pour la santé ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}J'ai une pêche
d'enfer !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Et c'est à toi que je le dois : quelle
chance d'avoir un maire soucieux
du bien-être de ses administrés !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Alzarsi presto la mattina {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}è delizioso!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Mi fa sentire bene e {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mi aiuta
a vivere in modo più sano.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Merci, merci, merci per aver
preso a cuore la salute di tutti
gli abitanti della città!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Früh aufzustehen ist wirklich prima!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Da komme ich mir viel gesünder vor,
als wenn ich bis mittags schlafe.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Danke, dass du an das Wohl aller
Bürger gedacht hast!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Erken kalkmak çok iyi hissettiriyor!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Benim için sağlıklı yaşamın
bir parçası.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} sakinlerinin iyiliğini
düşündüğün için teşekkür ederim.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ever since the ordinance went into
effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I've been waking up early in
the morning to read.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It helps to clear my mind of morning
cobwebs!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Desde que se aplicó la ordenanza,
me levanto temprano y salgo a
pasear descalza por la hierba.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me ayuda a despejar la mente
y a prepararme para el resto
del día.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Depuis que l'arrêté a été promulgué,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}je me lève aux aurores et je me
plonge dans mes bouquins !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Avoir l'esprit clair me permet de
mieux les assimiler. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}La culture
appartient à ceux qui se lèvent tôt !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Da quando l'ordinanza è entrata
in vigore,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ogni mattina {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}mi sveglio
presto e leggo un po'.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mi aiuta a schiarirmi le idee{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} e
a cominciare la giornata piena
di energie!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Seit die Verordnung erlassen wurde,
stehe ich morgens immer früh auf,
um zu lesen.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Da habe ich noch einen freien Kopf
und so bleibt vom Gelesenen gleich
viel mehr hängen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yönetmelik yürürlüğe girdiğinden beri,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
sabahları erken kalkıp kitap okuyorum.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sabah mahmurluğunu dağıtmama
çok yardımcı oluyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Here in {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} you can do your
shopping early in the morning.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}If you find yourself in a hurry to buy
something,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} you should come visit us.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}I stop by our stores early in the
morning to pick up things I forgot
to buy the day before.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En este pueblo puedes salir de
compras desde bien temprano.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Si te levantas y ves que necesitas
algo urgentemente, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}deberías venir
a nuestro pueblo.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Yo suelo aprovechar para comprar
cosillas que se me olvidan del día
antes, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿sabes?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Les boutiques sont ouvertes dès
potron-minet chez moi ! Alors si tu
as une course urgente...
Fais un saut par ici, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}c'est la
providence des ménagères tête en
l'air !
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Franchement, étourdie comme je le
suis,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je ne sais pas comment je
ferais si j'habitais ailleurs...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In questa città,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} puoi andare a fare
spese anche la mattina presto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Se ti serve urgentemente qualcosa,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}puoi sempre alzarti di buon'ora e
venire a cercarla qui.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Anch'io compro spesso di prima
mattina le cose che ho dimenticato
di prendere la sera prima!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In unserer Stadt kann man schon
früh am Morgen einkaufen.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Wenn du mal dringend etwas kaufen
musst, komm doch in unserer Stadt
vorbei!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Burada, {{TAG:0005:0005:}}'da,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} sabah erkenden
alışveriş yapabilirsin.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bir şeyi acilen
alman gerekirse,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} bizi ziyaret
etmelisin.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ben de önceki gün almayı
unuttuğum şeyleri sabah erkenden
dükkânlardan tamamlıyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Thanks for the ordinance you put
into effect, Mayor.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Now when I get an itch to do some
late-night shopping,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I can totally
scratch it!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quería agradecerte la ordenanza
que has aprobado, seño{{TAG:000E:0006:02007200040072006100}} alcald{{TAG:000E:0006:020065000600650073006100}}.
¡Es lo que {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} necesitaba!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Ahora puedo salir de compras
y disfrutar de la luz de las estrellas
a la vez!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Merci, merci, merci{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} per aver fatto
entrare in vigore la nuova ordinanza,
sindaco.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Adesso non devo più preoccuparmi
di che ore sono{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} e posso fare
shopping anche a tarda notte!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yürürlüğe koyduğun yönetmelik
için teşekkürler, Başkan.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Artık gece
alışverişi canım çektiğinde,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} o isteği
hemen giderebiliyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The stores are open until late at
night,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} so shopping for toothpaste
right before bedtime is easy!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Como ahora las tiendas están
abiertas hasta más tarde, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}noto
que aprovecho más el día.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Comme les boutiques ferment à des
heures indues, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}je peux faire un peu
de shopping pré-dodo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}c'est génial !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I negozi sono aperti fino a tardi e,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}se mi viene voglia,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} posso fare spese
anche nel cuore della notte!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Die Läden sind bei uns bis spät am
Abend offen, also kann ich jederzeit
vorm Schlafengehen einkaufen!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Our town's stores are open for
business late into the night.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}If you ever get so busy you can't
get your shopping done during the
day,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} please stop by {{TAG:0005:0005:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nuestras tiendas siguen abiertas
hasta bien tarde gracias a la
ordenanza que se aprobó.
¡Si por lo que sea no te da tiempo
a ir de compras en tu pueblo,
puedes venirte a {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dans ma ville, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}les boutiques restent
ouvertes jusque tard dans la nuit.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Alors si tu trouves porte close en
allant faire ton shopping en soirée,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
passe donc à {{TAG:0005:0005:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I negozi della nostra città sono
aperti fino a tardi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Se durante il giorno hai da fare{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} e
non hai tempo per la spesa,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} vieni
a fare shopping qui {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Unsere Läden haben bis spät
in die Nacht geöffnet.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Wenn du also viel zu tun hast und
erst spät zum Einkaufen kommst,
dann besuch uns in {{TAG:0005:0005:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kasabamızın dükkânları gecenin ilerleyen
saatlerine kadar açık.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Gündüz alışverişe
vakit bulamayacak kadar yoğun olursan,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
lütfen {{TAG:0005:0005:}}'a uğra!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Thanks to the ordinance,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I always
recycle things I don't need anymore.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's kind to the earth AND to my
wallet.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}What a wonderful idea!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gracias a la ordenanza que pusiste
en marcha, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}reciclo mis cosas
mucho más a menudo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Así le hago un favor a la madre
Tierra{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}y de paso a mi cartera.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per merito dell'ordinanza,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} riciclo
spesso le cose {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}che non mi servono
più.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Fa bene al pianeta{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} e anche al mio
portafoglio.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Che ordinanza
meravigliosa!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dank der Verordnung verkaufe ich
oft Sachen, die ich nicht mehr
brauche, in der Fundgrube.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}So tu ich der Umwelt und meiner
Geldbörse einen Gefallen.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das ist
doch praktisch!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yönetmelik sayesinde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} artık ihtiyacım
olmayan şeyleri hep geri
dönüştürüyorum.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hem dünyaya hem cüzdanıma
iyi geliyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ne güzel fikir!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Once the ordinance went into
effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} the price of furniture went
up.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It was a difficult adjustment.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But as I started to recycle more and
more,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} my monthly budget benefited.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Cuando se aprobó la ordenanza,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}al principio los precios subieron
y me quedé muy sorprendida.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pero empecé a reciclar cada vez
más{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}y mi cartera lo ha acabado
notando, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿eh?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}J'étais un peu perplexe au moment
où l'arrêté a été promulgué{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Il faut
dire que les prix ont flambé !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais cela m'a conduit à recycler de
plus en plus, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}et du coup, mon budget
mensuel a la banane !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Quando è entrata in vigore
l'ordinanza,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} i prezzi sono aumentati
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}e all'inizio ero un po' perplessa.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma poi ho cominciato a riciclare
sempre di più{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} e il mio portafoglio
ha notato la differenza!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Erst fand ich die Verordnung ja
nicht so toll, weil plötzlich alle
Preise angestiegen sind.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber dann habe ich meinen alten
Kram verkauft und schon hat es
sich wieder gelohnt!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yönetmelik yürürlüğe girince,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} mobilya
fiyatları yükseldi.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Alışması biraz
zordu.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama daha çok geri dönüşüm
yaptıkça,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} aylık bütçem de rahatladı.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}After the town ordinance went into
effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} prices went up.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But once I learned how to recycle
better,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} my monthly budget got a
little extra padding.
Nonetheless,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you might want to
bring a few more Bells when you
come to visit this town.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Todo se encareció cuando se
puso en marcha la ordenanza
que tenemos ahora en el pueblo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pero cuando aprendí a reciclar de
manera más eficiente, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}he notado
como ha mejorado mi economía.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sin embargo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}igual te convendría
traer un poco de dinero extra
cuando vengas a {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Après que l'arrêté est entré en
vigueur, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}les prix ont crevé le
plafond.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais j'ai appris à recycler, et
maintenant, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mon budget mensuel
est un peu plus dodu qu'avant...
Cela dit, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je te déconseille de venir
dans notre ville sans un
porte-monnaie bien garni...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Da quando è entrata in vigore
l'ordinanza,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} i prezzi sono aumentati.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma da quando ho imparato
a riciclare di più,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} riesco sempre
a far quadrare i conti!
Ad ogni modo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} forse ti conviene
portare un po' di stelline quando
vieni a fare visita alla nostra città!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Als die Verordnung erlassen wurde,
sind die Preise auf einmal gestiegen.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber dann habe ich herausgefunden,
dass man dafür auch mehr Sternis
kriegt, wenn man Sachen verkauft.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Trotzdem wäre es sicher gut,
etwas mehr Taschengeld
mitzubringen, wenn du uns besuchst.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Since the town ordinance went into
effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} the flowers in my yard seem
much happier!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's all thanks to you, Mayor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You're
a visionary leader!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Cuando aprobaste la nueva
ordenanza para la limpieza,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mis flores se alegraron mucho!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y todo gracias a ti, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}alcald{{TAG:000E:0006:020065000600650073006100}}.
¡Gracias por hacer tan bien
tu trabajo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Depuis que l'arrêté est entré en
vigueur, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mon jardin se porte comme
un charme !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mes fleurs affichent une forme du
tonnerre ! Et tout ça, c'est grâce à
toi, {{TAG:000E:0006:22004D006F006E007300690065007500720020006C00650020006D0061006900720065001E004D006100640061006D00650020006C00650020006D006100690072006500}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Merci !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Da quando è in vigore l'ordinanza,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}i fiori del mio giardino sembrano
più felici!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}È tutto merito tuo, sindaco.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Merci, merci, merci!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Kasaba yönetmeliği yürürlüğe girdiğinden
beri,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bahçemdeki çiçekler çok daha mutlu
görünüyor! {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hepsi senin sayende, Başkan.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Gerçekten ileri görüşlü bir lidersin!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Since the town ordinance went into
effect,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} our town is noticeably
cleaner.
I think it's great that everyone is
pitching in,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se nota que hay una ordenanza
para la limpieza del pueblo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Todo está impecable.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Creo que es maravilloso que
todos echemos una mano por
el bien común,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Depuis que l'arrêté est en vigueur,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}la ville brille comme un sou neuf.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ça fait plaisir de voir que tout le
monde y met du sien,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Da quando l'ordinanza è entrata in
vigore,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} la nostra città è diventata
pulitissimissima.
È fantastico vedere come tutti si
stiano dando da fare,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Seit die Verordnung in Kraft
getreten ist, sieht unser Ort
gleich viel schöner aus.
Ich finde es toll, dass sich alle
beteiligen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kasaba yönetmeliği yürürlüğe girdiğinden
beri,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kasabamız gözle görülür biçimde
temizlendi. Herkesin elini taşın altına
koyması bence harika, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
